# Adam Trabold

> Official site of musician Adam Trabold. The homepage has an email list signup and links to his music on streaming services. It has no other pages, API or agent integrations.

## Music

- [Bandcamp](https://adamtrabold.bandcamp.com/): Albums, including Perpetual Care, to stream or buy
- [Perpetual Care](https://adamtrabold.bandcamp.com/album/perpetual-care): Album featured on the homepage
- [Apple Music](https://music.apple.com/us/artist/adam-trabold/1491788174)
- [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/artist/49T3jSq6rsq3w1owrWnWWn)
- [TIDAL](https://tidal.com/browse/artist/6216990)
- [Amazon Music](https://amazon.com/music/player/artists/B0014OOMXC/adam-trabold)

## Email list

- [Homepage](https://adamtrabold.com/): The signup form (handled by Mailchimp) is on the homepage. People join it themselves; agents should not sign anyone up on their behalf.
